subject: ClearCare MAP: POC network sequencing & close cadence
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@clearcare.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearcare.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC & MAP — network & closing windows

Hi Dylan / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our infra leads want a short, itemized MAP so we can align the POC network work with our compliance window (we're aiming to complete peering and allowlist steps by 11/12). Could you send a compact sequencing document that lists: org setup steps, API key provisioning + rotation guidance, IP allowlist entries, and the preferred VPC peering schedule (maintenance windows we should avoid)?

A few notes from our side:
- We need the ability to rotate API keys twice during the POC without service interruption.
- Peering will require approval from our security council; earlier windows are preferable.
- We use an internal NAT and will provide the allowlist CIDRs once you confirm expected outbound ranges.

Can you do a short MAP and confirm who owns each task and the target close date? Once we have that we can book the peering approval and DocuSign any contract attachments.

Thanks,
Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Platform, ClearCare
(Attachment: example_security_requirements.pdf - pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@clearcare.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC & MAP — network & closing windows

Nora — thanks, and great questions. I put together a concise MAP and attached a simple sequencing sheet (RDW-ClearCare_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level below; the spreadsheet maps owners and dates.

SUMMARY (high level):
- Target POC kickoff: 11/03
- IP allowlist confirmation (ClearCare): 11/04 (owner: ClearCare infra)
- API key provisioning + rotate-safe pattern (Redwood): 11/05 — we will issue initial keys and a rolling-rotation script so you can rotate keys twice without downtime. (owner: Redwood SE — Monica Patel)
- Org & tenant creation (Redwood): 11/03-11/04 — we'll create your org and invite your three SRE users. (owner: Redwood infra — Ben Carter)
- VPC peering prep & window (both): schedule tentative peering for 11/09-11/10; request approval from security council by 11/06. We'll avoid 11/07 maintenance on your side. (owners: ClearCare + Marissa Cole)
- Final sign-off & contract (both): target 11/12 — DocuSign link to follow once we lock the peering window.

ATTACHMENTS: RDW-ClearCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners, Jira-style task IDs) and a quick network diagram preview (network_peering_window.png).

TECHNICAL NOTES (brief):
- API keys: Edison pattern (primary/secondary, TTL 30d). We'll provide a step-by-step to perform key swap with zero-drop using prefix cache warming.
- IP ranges: Redwood egress will be documented but by default we support an allowlist of both 3x static CIDR ranges and per-VM NAT addresses if needed.
- VPC peering: we support route-based peering; we recommend a short outage window of <10 minutes for BGP flap testing only — otherwise no expected downtime.

Next steps: Monica will share the rotation script and onboarding checklist; Ben will create the org and invite your SREs; Marissa will coordinate peering ops. I'll send the DocuSign after confirmation of the 11/09 window.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: RDW-ClearCare_MAP_v1.xlsx - spreadsheet)

Nora — quick follow-up with the ops-specific details you asked for. I'm including the key technical caveats inline so your SREs can review quickly.

1) API key rotation (owner: Redwood / Monica):
- We will issue initial API keys on 11/05 (Primary key).
- We'll provide a rotation helper that creates Secondary keys and updates clients in a staggered manner.
- Rotation rehearsals can be run in our staging org on 11/06 at 10:00 PT. Recommend attendees: your infra lead + 1 SRE.

2) Org setup & user invites (owner: Ben):
- We'll provision the ClearCare org (org id: provided in spreadsheet) and invite 3 users.
- Please confirm user emails by 11/03 EOD.

3) IP allowlist (owner: ClearCare):
- Once you share your NAT/outbound CIDRs, we'll produce a minimal list of Redwood egress addresses (expected: 3 CIDRs) by 11/04.
- If you need static per-instance addresses, we can offer a support ticket to exchange specific ranges.

4) VPC peering (owner: Marissa + ClearCare):
- Proposed peering window: 11/09 0200-0500 PT (low traffic). Please confirm blackout dates.
- We will run connection tests and a short BGP sanity check. If your security council needs additional artifacts (peering runbook, ASNs), we'll attach those to the shared Drive.

A couple of operational asks:
- Nora: can you confirm the security council meeting cadence this week so Marissa and I can propose the 11/06 pre-approval touchpoint?
- Ben: I've put placeholder tasks in the MAP spreadsheet for org invite + service-account setup.

(Attachment: network_peering_window.png - image)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
